parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Filters servers by the authenticated user's relationship to them.

If empty (the default), all servers the authenticated user has access to will be returned.

If set to `owner`, only servers the authenticated user directly owns will be returned.

(Admin-only) If set to `admin`, all servers the authenticated user doesn't own will be returned.

(Admin-only) If set to `admin-all`, all servers on the panel will be returned.
